The '''Wrathor''' was a position on the [[Royal Court]] of [[Virujansi/Legends|Virujansi]]. The Wrathor's role was to relate the [[Rajah]]'s displeasure with the terms of the supplicant's proposal, often using colorful and elaborate insults.
